ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels; high-intensity regions dominate the outer lobes, while low-intensity regions are concentrated centrally and along the leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive contiguous high-intensity regions on both distal lobes; a large, low-intensity wedge-shaped region originating at the median notch and extending basally; multiple discrete low-intensity circular mottling spots (approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the light regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; the depth of the notch is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel amplitudes varying between 2 and 12 pixels; trailing edge contains approximately 18 distinct peaks on the left lobe and 16 on the right lobe, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the upper trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in rounded, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular, high-contrast dark-pixel clusters on white backgrounds distributed across the middle sections of both lobes; several larger clusters (approximately 10-15 pixels) are visible near the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three parallel, low-intensity diagonal linear marks (scratches) visible on the upper section of the right lobe; additional shorter unaligned marks present near the center of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting historical tissue loss; several deep, dark circular marks suggesting healed parasitic or barnacle lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark 'Y' shaped pigmentation pattern branching from the peduncle base toward the center of each fluke lobe.
